summary.en: Bump the jsdom development dependency from 30.1.1 to 31.0.0 and refresh the lockfile.
summary.zh: 将开发依赖 jsdom 从 30.1.1 升级到 31.0.0，并刷新锁文件。

reason: Development-only DOM test dependency. It does not change product behavior, setup, entry points or any documented version, so no guide needs an update.

compatibility.en: No save, configuration or runtime behavior changes; the game has no frontend build step and jsdom is not shipped.
compatibility.zh: 不改变存档、配置或运行时行为；游戏没有前端构建步骤，jsdom 不打入发布包。
